_about: The persistent pre-prod sim tenant set. One entry per workspace, one per fleet inside it. Read by provy-sim scripts/sim_set.py and by provy-sim-control scripts/provision-sim-set.mts. The nightly sweep only deletes @argustest.com users and a tenant named 'Nightly Certification', so these logins live on demo.provy.ai and the names start with 'Sim '. A ground-truth file per tenant (ground_truth/sim_tenants/<key>.json) says what the product must say about it.

tenants.name: Sim H1 Healthy
tenants.purpose: Healthy, fully instrumented fleet: all six context signals on every model step, settled outcomes, a well calibrated agent claim, learned checks established, a Growth fleet plan, and a notices recipient who is not the owner.

tenants.name: Sim H2 Thin Context
tenants.purpose: Thin context like Third Eye: a record on model steps only, one agent that runs code and no model (no record, not counted), source age on some items only, no instruction fingerprint. Enterprise fleet plan with a typed fee, a tiny pool so extra usage is real, and a 100 percent internal discount.

order.reason: Sim set: Enterprise fleet plan with an internal discount, like Third Eye

tenants.name: Sim H3 No Context
tenants.purpose: The customer who never sent a manifest: nothing breaks, every context answer reads unknown, never a pass. Pilot ending in 14 days on a Startup fleet plan.

order.reason: Sim set: pilot ending in 14 days

tenants.name: Sim H4 Planted Faults
tenants.purpose: Planted stale sources, unapproved sources and empty retrievals with a declared 30 day limit and approved list. The ground truth lists every planted fault by session. No order on file.

tenants.name: Sim H5 Instruction Change
tenants.purpose: Three instruction stories on three agents: a real change, an A-B-A-B alternating rollout, and a same-label fingerprint change. Pilot ending in 3 days on a Scale fleet plan.

order.reason: Sim set: pilot ending in 3 days

tenants.name: Sim H6 Declared Checks
tenants.purpose: Declared Guardrails checks (a freshness limit and an approved list), then a check switched off, then switched on again, with traffic in each phase. A per-agent order, for the case that is not a fleet plan.

tenants.name: Sim H7 Outcomes Duo
tenants.purpose: Two fleets in one workspace. One agent states its confidence and is right about as often as it says; the other states 0.9 and is right about half the time. Each contract has a condition that can be measured and one that never can. Only the first fleet declares a 30 day limit and an approved list: proves a declaration lands on the card's own fleet (#1630).

tenants.name: Sim H8 Doors
tenants.purpose: The same planned story sent by five doors: the SDK, OpenTelemetry, direct JSON, a log line and a log field map. Readiness is identical on the first four. The field map cannot carry three of the six signals, and that is a documented limit of the door.

fleets.name: Sim H8 via log field map

tenants.name: Sim H9 Agent Roster
tenants.purpose: A roster with a retired agent and an agent that sent data and was never accepted, next to agents that count. Retries and step ids: every step is sent twice and must be stored once.

tenants.name: Sim P1 Pilot Ended
tenants.purpose: A pilot that ended 5 days ago and was not converted. The roll pauses Provy's optional model work for it; the staff panel says so.

order.reason: Sim set: pilot ended 5 days ago, not converted

tenants.name: Sim P2 Pilot Converted
tenants.purpose: A pilot that ended and was converted: a later paid order with no pilot date.

tenants.name: Sim P3 Pilot Extended
tenants.purpose: A pilot that was about to end and was extended by staff: the end date moves out, the state reads running.

order.extend_reason: Sim set: pilot extended by staff
